correctness.rationale: The proof reduces the character to finite signed relative-chain traces using the established wedge concentration; it classifies all admissible complement sets (0..4), proves their absence for larger sizes, counts fixed triples and four-blocks for every dihedral element, and applies Hopf trace. Exact finite independent enumeration checks all 434 dihedral elements at n=9..22, all ordinary 3-cut chain Lefschetz traces at n=9..12 and boundary ranks. The all-n claim relies on the proved combinatorics and cited shellability, not on finite enumeration.

value.rationale: This is the complete rational dihedral symmetry representation of the natural squared-cycle ordinary three-cut complex for every n>=9. It distinguishes vertex-axis and edge-axis reflections and reveals an alternating pattern in dihedral fixed-space dimensions invisible to homology ranks and known cyclic characters. The all-parameter trace makes symmetry-based quotient invariants accessible; it is a substantive structural refinement, not a routine change of parameters.
